intro: Jinar'Zillen of Shadowprey Village in Desolace likes to do as little as possible. Many shellfish traps sit below the village docks, and anyone who gathers the shellfish from them will be repaid with something worth having.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'll reward anyone who makes my life a bit easier... I enjoy doing as little as possible, mon!

Below the docks here in Shadowprey Village, I've many shellfish traps. If you're kind enough to do my work and collect me my shellfish, then I'll reward you with something you want... Get my drift mon? For every five shellfish you bring me I will give you a fine Bloodbelly fish!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Sweet mon, nothing beats work being done, especially if it's someone else doing the work... Eh?
